name: smwmusic-castlevania-the-adventure-battle-of-the-holy
title: Castlevania: The Adventure - Battle of the Holy
description:
An unsampled version of the first level music from Castlevania Adventure for GB. Includes four variants, of which both different TXT files have different intros and ADSR values and each includes info on tempo customization. Arrangement tempo has been set by default, but you can also set the original tempo.

Best for castle levels, of course.
